verification.details: Standard tau-voice agent prompt, user-simulator prompt, domain policies (data/tau2/domains/<domain>/policy.md), tool schemas, tool results, and evaluator are byte-identical to upstream -- no file in the tau-voice repo is modified. The agent additionally receives a prepended scaffold system message defining each agent's identity and role (real-time voice agent vs. background tool-calling agent), the responsibilities it owns, and how the two coordinate and share context. Full base splits: retail 114, airline 50, telecom 114; 1 trial per task at regular speech complexity; no task omitted. User-side voices are local ElevenLabs personas from setup_voices (not Sierra-managed submission voices).

methodology.notes:
Custom submission from Pine AI. The agent is a two-agent system: (1) a voice agent handling real-time speech via a customized ASR -> LLM -> TTS pipeline coordinated by a custom interaction model that governs turn-taking, backchanneling, and other conversational dynamics; (2) a background agent (gemini-3.5-flash) that issues the tool calls for the operational task. The two agents share context.
All voice-side models are the same production models serving 19pine.ai -- not benchmark-trained. No files in this tau-voice repo are modified. On top of the standard tau-voice agent system prompt, we prepend an additional scaffold system message that defines each agent's identity and role (the real-time voice agent vs. the background tool-calling agent), the responsibilities each one owns, and how the two coordinate and share context.
Full base splits evaluated on all three domains (retail 114, airline 50, telecom 114), 1 trial per task, --speech-complexity regular. User simulator is the standard v1.0 pipeline (gpt-4.1). User-side voices are local ElevenLabs personas created via the standard setup_voices script; not Sierra-managed submission voices.
We observed material score sensitivity to the user-simulator LLM on the leaderboard, so we also publish a companion result under the same agent with a stronger simulator LLM (see corresponding submission with user_simulator = "gpt-5.5-2026-04-23 (xhigh)").
